_doc.description: Coreon Runbook M1 — deterministic training-plan templates.

structure.default_paces_min_per_mi: Used by the renderer to convert distance → duration estimate. Replaced by real user paces in M2.
structure.phase_workouts_shared: Base-phase workouts shared across all race goals (and used 100% by base-fitness goal).
structure.goals: Per-goal config: phase distribution, peak-volume targets, long-run cap, and per-phase workout libraries for build/peak/taper.
structure.workout_selection: Generator rotates deterministically: workouts[ (week_within_phase) % workouts.length ]. No randomness.

_doc.edit_safely: Adding workouts to a phase's array is safe — the generator just gets a bigger rotation. Removing or reordering may shift which workout appears on which week for existing plans; bump engine_version when making such changes (see ARCHITECTURE_SPEC.md §2).

base.label: Strides
base.workout: 6 × 20-sec strides at race effort with full recovery, after a 3-mi easy run

base.label: Hill strides
base.workout: 5 × 60-sec uphill at strong effort, walk-down recovery — or 5 × 60-sec hard on flat at 5K effort with 90-sec jog recovery if no hills. Easy warmup + cooldown either way.

base.label: Easy tempo
base.workout: 2 mi easy + 2 mi at comfortable hard effort + 2 mi easy

base.label: Progression
base.workout: Run easy → moderate → strong, ~1.5 mi each segment

base.label: Fartlek
base.workout: 20 min easy with 5 × 1-min surges at 5K effort, 1 min easy between

build.label: Threshold tempo
build.workout: 3 mi at threshold effort, after easy warmup

peak.label: Race sim
peak.workout: 2 mi at 5K effort, 4-min easy, 1 mi all-out

taper.label: Tune-up
taper.workout: 3 × 400m at race pace, full recovery between

taper.label: Race strides
taper.workout: 6 × 30-sec at race pace with full recovery, after easy warmup

taper.label: Shakeout
taper.workout: Easy 20-min run with 4 × 20-sec race-pace pickups in the last mile

peak.label: Mixed pace
peak.workout: 2 mi at threshold + 4 × 800m at 5K effort with 90-sec recovery

peak.label: Race sim
peak.workout: 3 mi at 10K effort, 5-min easy, 1 mi at 5K effort

taper.label: Race strides
taper.workout: 6 × 30-sec at race pace with full recovery, after easy warmup

build.label: Mile repeats
build.workout: 5 × 1 mi at half-marathon effort, 90-sec jog recovery

build.label: Steady-state
build.workout: 6 mi at moderate effort (just below threshold)

build.label: Progression LR
build.workout: Long run with last 3 mi at half-marathon effort

peak.label: Half-pace block
peak.workout: 6 mi at half-marathon effort, after easy warmup

peak.label: Mixed pace
peak.workout: 3 × 1 mi at threshold + 3 × 1 mi at half-marathon effort, 90-sec recovery

peak.label: Race-pace LR
peak.workout: Long run with last 5 mi at half-marathon effort

taper.label: Race-pace miles
taper.workout: 2 × 1 mi at half-marathon effort, 3-min easy between

build.label: Threshold tempo
build.workout: 5 mi at threshold effort (just below half-marathon pace)

build.label: Progression LR
build.workout: Long run with last 3 mi at marathon effort

peak.label: MP block
peak.workout: 8 mi at marathon effort, after easy warmup

peak.label: Race-pace LR
peak.workout: Long run with last 6 mi at marathon effort

peak.label: Mixed pace LR
peak.workout: Long run: middle 4 mi at marathon effort, finish 2 mi at half-marathon effort

taper.label: Short race strides
taper.workout: 6 × 30-sec at half-marathon effort with full recovery, after easy warmup
